giver: Mandy, outside her house in Key Lento
steps: Talk to Mandy outside her house
Follow her inside to the bedroom
Grab the plunger in the bathroom across from the bedroom
Use the plunger on the kitchen sink
Use the wrench on the pipe
Pick up the cigar box Mandy throws into the street
tips: Finish Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch and Unwanted Attention first
The Macizo Cigar is only yours if you pick up the box from the street
